notes: 75 source examples were surveyed during D20 design. None have operative Geard mechanics.
Do not use previous D20 fit/reject classifications as final. Stamina-type effects can be adapted to Geard's Fatigue, while percentual combat effects require Potence/Resilience design.

Original Skyrim 0–100 numeric gates are retained as candidate minimums on the combined rating: a perk-named Attribute + governed starting Talent + Skill + one eligible Specialty (0–25 each), never the Skill rating alone. Each perk's Attribute and allowed Specialties still need conversion.
Starting Talents have no perk trees. Double-confirmed personal 10s and attacker personal 1s award bankable character perk points; external equipment dice never earn such points.

items.name: Critical Charge
items.prior_note: Sprint into a stronger one-handed attack; map sprint/power attack and critical damage.

items.name: Dual Flurry
items.prior_note: Faster dual attacks require a specific extra-attack/action-economy rule.

items.name: Hack and Slash
items.prior_note: Axe attacks inflict additional bleed; define ongoing damage/stacking.

items.name: Armsman
items.prior_note: Percentage damage multiplier duplicates the accepted +skill/5 flat damage scaling.

items.name: Sweep
items.prior_note: A sideways power attack catches multiple nearby enemies; define threatened arc and attacks.

items.name: Great Critical Charge
items.prior_note: Sprinting two-handed power attack; requires power-attack and critical action rules.

items.name: Barbarian
items.prior_note: Percentage base damage duplicates skill-derived damage bonuses.

items.name: Hunter's Discipline
items.prior_note: Retrieve twice as many usable arrows after combat; ammo recovery is narrative bookkeeping.

items.name: Ranger
items.prior_note: Move without losing readied bow/aim; specify move/ready interaction.

items.name: Power Shot
items.prior_note: On a strong arrow hit, stagger; need condition/defense procedure.

items.name: Steady Hand
items.prior_note: Slow-time aiming becomes focus/aim/reaction rule in turn-based combat.

items.name: Power Bash
items.prior_note: Unlock shield power-bash maneuver once bash attack action is specified.

items.name: Deflect Arrows
items.prior_note: Shield can fully stop arrows; replace real-time shield-hit detection with legal Block reaction.

items.name: Block Runner
items.prior_note: Move while keeping shield raised; map movement/action availability.

items.name: Elemental Protection
items.prior_note: Halve elemental effects when shield blocks; define timing and resource.

items.name: Conditioning
items.prior_note: Worn heavy armor contributes no encumbrance or movement penalty.

items.name: Cushioned
items.prior_note: Halve falling HP damage with a full heavy-armor suit.

items.name: Tower of Strength
items.prior_note: Reduce stagger when fully heavy-armored; needs stagger rule.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.prior_note: Percent armor-rating multiplier breaks calibrated additive AC.

items.name: Hand to Hand: Journeyman ghost striking
items.prior_note: Unarmed techniques affect ghosts/ethereal targets; depends on insubstantiality rules.

items.name: Hand to Hand: side power attack
items.prior_note: Unarmed power maneuver can disarm; define D20 maneuver.

items.name: Athletics: sprint fatigue mastery
items.prior_note: No Stamina pool, so fatigue regeneration perk has no direct target.

items.name: Acrobatics: attack during jumps
items.prior_note: Allow a normal attack while leaping/falling; requires legal movement.

items.name: Arcane Blacksmith
items.prior_note: Temper/improve enchanted weapons and armor.

items.name: Dwarven Smithing
items.prior_note: Use Dwarven crafting process and improve results; requires recipe/craft DC.

items.name: Daedric Smithing
items.prior_note: Craft Daedric equipment with necessary materials and recipe access.

items.name: Stability
items.prior_note: Longer Alteration duration; define duration multiplier.

items.name: Mage Armor
items.prior_note: Enhances flesh protection while unarmored; AC stacking and magic scale must be defined.

items.name: Atronach
items.prior_note: Absorb incoming magical energy; define resisted spell and Magicka restore.

items.name: Summoner
items.prior_note: Extend conjuration summon/reanimate range twofold.

items.name: Atromancy
items.prior_note: Double atronach summoning duration.

items.name: Soul Stealer
items.prior_note: Bound weapons also apply Soul Trap on hit, subject to soul rules.

items.name: Oblivion Binding
items.prior_note: Bound strikes banish summons and turn reanimated foes; requires effects system.

items.name: Twin Souls
items.prior_note: Allow two concurrent summons; encounter balance and summon-slot system needed.

items.name: Rune Master
items.prior_note: Place magical runes at five times their normal range.

items.name: Impact
items.prior_note: Dual-cast Destruction spells can stagger; define dual casting and save.

items.name: Intense Flames
items.prior_note: Weak targets struck by fire may flee; define threshold and fear mechanic.

items.name: Quiet Casting
items.prior_note: Spells cast from any school make no audible casting sound.

items.name: Master of the Mind
items.prior_note: Mind effects can target undead, daedra and constructs; define immunities and exceptions.

items.name: Animage
items.prior_note: Improve influence on animals; no target level cap in this system.

items.name: Oblivion Mysticism spell mastery ranks
items.prior_note: Spell-tier access isn't a perk to copy verbatim into the classless engine.

items.name: Skyrim ward/absorption effects from other schools
items.prior_note: Spell absorption, Soul Trap and detection inspire future Mysticism perks; no direct Skyrim tree.

items.name: Ward Absorb
items.prior_note: Absorbing hostile spells with a ward restores Magicka, magnitude needs tuning.

items.name: Necromage
items.prior_note: Enhanced magic against undead; decide size/target type.

items.name: Avoid Death
items.prior_note: Limited automatic emergency healing; convert fixed 250 HP to level-free Health scale.

items.name: Respite
items.prior_note: Restores Stamina, which Elf-Books deliberately removed.

items.name: Green Thumb
items.prior_note: Gather double the number of ingredients from plants.

items.name: Concentrated Poison
items.prior_note: One weapon poison application remains effective for twice as many hits.

items.name: Experimenter
items.prior_note: Eating an ingredient reveals additional alchemical effects; rank specifics follow Skyrim.

items.name: Purity
items.prior_note: Craft potions without unwanted harmful effects and poisons without unwanted helpful effects.

items.name: Extra Effect
items.prior_note: A finished item can hold two enchantments, with normal resource requirements.

items.name: Soul Squeezer
items.prior_note: Soul gems provide more recharge energy; define recharge costs.

items.name: Soul Siphon
items.prior_note: Defeating nonhuman foes recharges wielded enchanted weapon; needs souls model.

items.name: Unhindered
items.prior_note: Light armor worn imposes no encumbrance or movement penalty.

items.name: Deft Movement
items.prior_note: Chance to evade all melee damage; avoid adding hidden invulnerability to AC.

items.name: Wind Walker
items.prior_note: Only modifies Stamina regeneration; no equivalent resource.

items.name: Oblivion Acrobatics: jumping attacks
items.prior_note: May attack while jumping/falling; may also fit Athletics; decide authoritative mapping.

items.name: Oblivion Acrobatics: rolling dodge
items.prior_note: Rapid tumble to avoid attacks, translating dodge ability into action-economy option.

items.name: Light Foot
items.prior_note: Avoid activating mundane pressure plates through careful movement.

items.name: Silence
items.prior_note: Walking/running at normal pace carries no added movement-noise detection penalty.

items.name: Shadow Warrior
items.prior_note: Break target tracking briefly in combat; turn-based perception and invisibility required.

items.name: Backstab
items.prior_note: Sixfold damage clashes with existing flat skill damage, HP balance and ambush system.

items.name: Quick Hands
items.prior_note: Can work a lock discreetly without inherently revealing the activity.

items.name: Wax Key
items.prior_note: Successful picking yields a copy of the key when a copyable key exists.

items.name: Unbreakable
items.prior_note: Normal lockpicks are not destroyed by picking failures.

items.name: Treasure Hunter
items.prior_note: Changes chest loot probability rather than character ability; GM owns world inventory.

items.name: Poisoned
items.prior_note: Slip poison onto an unsuspecting target to cause its normal effects.

items.name: Misdirection
items.prior_note: May lift a worn/readied weapon from an unsuspecting target.

items.name: Perfect Touch
items.prior_note: May remove equipped gear from an unsuspecting target.

items.name: Merchant
items.prior_note: Negotiate trade of categories outside a shop's usual merchandise, subject to NPC consent.

items.name: Bribery
items.prior_note: Gain ability to bribe guards to overlook lesser offenses; no universal NPC mind control.

items.name: Investor
items.prior_note: Fund businesses to increase working capital; economy/world persistence needed.

items.name: Master Trader
items.prior_note: Every merchant in the world receiving free gold isn't grounded in a solo GM simulation.

items.name: No equivalent Skyrim perk tree
items.prior_note: Design separately using Elder Scrolls' environmental gameplay rather than fabricating a vanilla tree.

items.name: No equivalent Skyrim perk tree
items.prior_note: Design research and scholarship perks from existing gameplay; no standalone Skyrim Lore tree.
